summary.tldr: Clarifies in the Criminal Code that sterilization procedures count as wounding or maiming under the assault offence.
what_it_does: Adds a rule to the Criminal Code saying a sterilization procedure is an act that wounds or maims a person for subsection 268(1).

Defines “sterilization procedure” as cutting, clipping, tying or cauterizing the Fallopian tubes, ovaries or uterus, or any other procedure that permanently prevents reproduction, even if surgery could later reverse it.
summary.background: The bill adds a new section after section 268 of the Criminal Code.
